BG_ALL_FOR_ONE.title: All for One
BG_ALL_FOR_ONE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Put all 0-cost cards from your discard pile into your hand.
BG_AMPLIFY.title: Amplify
BG_BALL_LIGHTNING.title: Ball Lightning
BG_BARRAGE.title: Barrage
BG_BARRAGE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each orb you have{IfUpgraded:show:, +1|}.
BG_BEAM_CELL.title: Beam Cell
BG_BEAM_CELL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
{IfUpgraded:show:Apply|If the die shows 1-3, apply} {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
BG_BLIZZARD.title: Blizzard
BG_BLIZZARD.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies for each [gold]Frost[/gold] orb you have.
BG_BUFFER.title: Buffer
BG_BUFFER.description: The next {Magic:diff()} {Magic:plural:time|times} you would lose HP, prevent it.
BG_CAPACITOR.title: Capacitor
BG_CHAOS.title: Chaos
BG_CHAOS.description: [gold]Channel[/gold] the orb the die is on: 1-2 [gold]Lightning[/gold], 3-4 [gold]Frost[/gold], 5-6 [gold]Dark[/gold].
BG_CHARGE_BATTERY.title: Charge Battery
BG_CHARGE_BATTERY.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} if you have 3 or more orbs.
BG_CLAW.title: Claw
BG_CLAW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Deals {Magic:diff()} more if the top card of your discard pile costs 0.
BG_COLD_SNAP.title: Cold Snap
BG_COMPILE_DRIVER.title: Compile Driver
BG_COMPILE_DRIVER.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw a card for each kind of orb you have.
BG_CONSUME.title: Consume
BG_COOLHEADED.title: Coolheaded
BG_CORE_SURGE.title: Core Surge
BG_CORE_SURGE.description:
Remove all [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] from {IfUpgraded:show:ALL players|any player}.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
BG_DARKNESS.title: Darkness
BG_DEFRAGMENT.title: Defragment
BG_DOOM_AND_GLOOM.title: Doom and Gloom
BG_DOUBLE_ENERGY.title: Double Energy
BG_ECHO_FORM.title: Echo Form
BG_ECHO_FORM.description: The first Attack or Skill you play each turn is played twice.
BG_ELECTRODYNAMICS.title: Electrodynamics
BG_EQUILIBRIUM.title: Equilibrium
BG_EQUILIBRIUM.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
You may [gold]Retain[/gold] up to {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} this turn.
BG_FTL.title: FTL
BG_FTL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If this is the first card you played this turn, draw {Cards:diff()} card.
BG_FISSION.title: Fission
BG_FISSION.description:
{IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Evoke[/gold]|Remove} all your orbs.
For each, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.
BG_FORCE_FIELD.title: Force Field
BG_FORCE_FIELD.description:
Costs 1 less for each Power you have in play.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
BG_FUSION.title: Fusion
BG_FUSION.description: At the start of your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
BG_GLACIER.title: Glacier
BG_GO_FOR_THE_EYES.title: Go for the Eyes
BG_GO_FOR_THE_EYES.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
{IfUpgraded:show:Apply|If the die shows 4-6, apply} {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
BG_HEATSINKS.title: Heatsinks
BG_HEATSINKS.description: Whenever you play a Power, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
BG_HOLOGRAM.title: Hologram
BG_HOLOGRAM.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Put a card from your discard pile into your hand.
BG_HYPERBEAM.title: Hyperbeam
BG_HYPERBEAM.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Remove all your orbs.
BG_LEAP.title: Leap
BG_LOOP.title: Loop
BG_LOOP.description: At the end of your turn, trigger an orb's end-of-turn ability{IfUpgraded:show: twice|}.
BG_MACHINE_LEARNING.title: Machine Learning
BG_MACHINE_LEARNING.description: At the start of your turn, draw {Cards:diff()} additional card.
BG_MELTER.title: Melter
BG_MELTER.description:
Remove all [gold]Block[/gold] from the enemy.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
BG_METEOR_STRIKE.title: Meteor Strike
BG_METEOR_STRIKE.description:
Costs 1 less for each Power you have in play.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
BG_MULTI_CAST.title: Multi-Cast
BG_OVERCLOCK.title: Overclock
BG_OVERCLOCK.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Put a [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your discard pile.
BG_RAINBOW.title: Rainbow
BG_RECURSION.title: Recursion
BG_RECURSION.description: [gold]Evoke[/gold] an orb, then [gold]Channel[/gold] another of the same kind.
BG_RECYCLE.title: Recycle
BG_RECYCLE.description: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card. Gain Energy equal to its cost. If it costs X, double your Energy instead.
BG_REINFORCED_BODY.title: Reinforced Body
BG_REINFORCED_BODY.description: {IfUpgraded:show:Gain X [gold]Block[/gold] twice.|Gain X+1 [gold]Block[/gold]. X can't be 0.}
BG_REPROGRAM.title: Reprogram
BG_SCRAPE.title: Scrape
BG_SCRAPE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the top card of your discard pile costs 0, return it to your hand.
BG_SEEK.title: Seek
BG_SEEK.description: Put {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your draw pile into your hand, then shuffle your draw pile.
BG_SKIM.title: Skim
BG_STACK.title: Stack
BG_STACK.description: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] to any player equal to the number of orbs you have{IfUpgraded:show:, +1|}.
BG_STATIC_DISCHARGE.title: Static Discharge
BG_STEAM_BARRIER.title: Steam Barrier
BG_STEAM_BARRIER.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gain {Magic:diff()} more if the top card of your discard pile costs 0.
BG_STORM.title: Storm
BG_STORM.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Channel[/gold] {Magic:diff()} [gold]Lightning[/gold].
BG_STREAMLINE.title: Streamline
BG_STREAMLINE.description:
Costs 1 less for each Power you have in play.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
BG_SUNDER.title: Sunder
BG_SUNDER.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If this kills the enemy, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
BG_SWEEPING_BEAM.title: Sweeping Beam
BG_SWEEPING_BEAM.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Draw {Cards:diff()} card.
BG_TEMPEST.title: Tempest
BG_THUNDER_STRIKE.title: Thunder Strike
BG_THUNDER_STRIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies for each [gold]Lightning[/gold] orb you have.
BG_TURBO.title: TURBO
BG_TURBO.description:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Put a [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your discard pile.
